mechanism: Both agents are beta-blockers/have beta-blocking effects; propafenone has Class IC antiarrhythmic and beta-blocking properties, leading to additive negative inotropic and chronotropic effects with systemic timolol absorption.
action: Monitor cardiac function, heart rate, and blood pressure closely; consider alternative antiarrhythmic if possible or dose adjustment; assess for signs of bradycardia, heart block, or heart failure.
